marketing.heroTitle: Never Miss a Dose. Take Control of Your Health.
marketing.heroSubtitle: Sehetak bridges smart meal-anchored schedules, automated Web Push, instant Telegram reminders, and elderly caregiver synchronization.
marketing.howItWorksTitle: How Sehetak Works in 3 Simple Steps
marketing.howItWorksSubtitle: A medical system combining simplicity for elderly users with smart background reminders for caregivers.
marketing.step1Desc: Register blood pressure or diabetes medications anchored to meal times for automatic dynamic shifting.
marketing.step2Desc: Generate a 6-character code and share it with your son or caregiver to oversee your schedule in seconds.
marketing.step3Desc: Receive alerts via Telegram and Web Push even when closed, with missed-dose alerts sent to caregivers.
marketing.feature1Desc: Dynamic times automatically adapt when your daily breakfast, lunch, or dinner time changes.
marketing.feature2Desc: Native RTL Arabic and LTR English support built specifically for Arab world patients.
marketing.feature3Desc: 1-click integration with our Telegram bot for seamless reminders anywhere.
marketing.aboutDesc: Empowering chronic care patients with meal-anchored medication routines, instant Telegram bot alerts, and comprehensive adherence insights.
marketing.aboutCard1Desc: All user data, prescriptions, and health metrics are secured using Supabase Row Level Security (RLS) policies and encrypted server configurations.
marketing.aboutCard2Desc: By anchoring medications around daily meal times and sending multi-channel reminders, Sehetak dramatically improves chronic condition management.
marketing.contactDesc: Have questions about medication schedules or Telegram bot integration? We are here to help.
marketing.contactAvailableBadge: Available 24/7 for urgent medication alert support.
marketing.contactSuccess: Thank you! Your message has been sent successfully.

caregiver.noRelativesDesc: Ask your parent for their family invite code and enter it above to start monitoring their medications.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we safeguard your medical & personal data on Sehetak
privacy.section1Desc: We collect minimal information necessary to deliver medication schedules, Web Push notifications, and Telegram reminder alerts.
privacy.section2Desc: Your medication logs, prescriptions, and health metrics are strictly isolated using Row Level Security (RLS) policies on encrypted Supabase servers.
privacy.section3Desc: We never sell, rent, or monetize your health data with commercial entities or advertisers. Notifications are strictly for platform functionality.
privacy.section4Desc: You retain full ownership of your data and can update or permanently delete your account and medication logs at any time from Settings.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions of Service
terms.subtitle: Guidelines and rules governing the use of the Sehetak digital platform
terms.section1Desc: Sehetak is a digital software reminder assistant. It does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment recommendations, or replace professional healthcare provider advice.
terms.section2Desc: Users are responsible for ensuring dosage amounts, times, and doctor appointment instructions entered into the platform are accurate.
terms.section3Desc: Delivery of Telegram alerts and Web Push notifications depends on your active device internet connectivity and granted browser permissions.
terms.section4Desc: We reserve the right to refine service terms and introduce enhanced features to elevate user health management and compliance.
